column1: # Akan tone+nasality lexicon: word<TAB>tones(H/L per nucleus)<TAB>nasals(+/- per nucleus).
# Mined from the tone/nasality-marked kaikki Akan readings + Paster (2010) attested isolated verb tones.
# Small coverage (the OOV tail has no tone — Akan tone is lexical and no large toned corpus exists);
# consumed by the SHIPPED phonemizeWord (rule path phonemizeWordRules stays tone-free / non-circular).
